cover.headline: Few sponsors cross the AFL-NRL line.
cover.deal: 33 AFL and NRL clubs, SSS database

caption:
Few sponsors cross the AFL-NRL line.

We counted the current partners at 17 AFL and 16 NRL clubs. That is 1,129 different brands, and only 74 of them back both codes.

McDonald's is at 16 clubs, eight in each code. Elastoplast is at 12, six in each. Gatorade is at 17, but 15 of those are AFL.

This is our database, not the whole market. Read the full story: link in bio
